facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Passepartout was a loyal servant. He helped Fogg every day. Loyalty means staying by someone's side. Passepartout was loyal.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Passepartout wanted a quiet life but followed Fogg around the world. He never complained even when things got difficult or dangerous. He bravely helped rescue Aouda in the Indian jungle. Passepartout showed his loyalty through actions, not just words. Passepartout was loyal. True loyalty means being there especially when times are hard.
facts.Page story text 3 (draft, teacher check: Passepartout had dreamed of a peaceful, predictable life when he became Fogg's servant. Instead, he found himself on the most unpredictable journey imaginable across the entire globe. Despite every hardship — extreme weather, dangerous encounters, and exhausting travel — he never once complained. His bravery during Aouda's rescue proved that his loyalty went far beyond mere duty. Passepartout was loyal. However, Passepartout's loyalty was not blind obedience but genuine devotion born from respect. Because he truly believed in Fogg's character, he willingly faced every challenge alongside his master. Fogg could never have succeeded without Passepartout's unwavering support and cheerful spirit.
facts.Word cards: loyal = 충성스러운 / servant = 하인 / lively = 활발한 / stood by = 곁에 있었다
